**PotentialPunch 1.0.0**, the first release.

A transient shaper for your MPC: more or less punch at the start of every hit, and more or less tail after it, with no threshold to set. 12 one-tap presets for drums, breaks and more. See the [README](https://github.com/PotentialBreakfast/mpc-vst-potentialpunch#readme) for everything it does and its limitations.

**Download** `PotentialPunch-1.0.0-mpc-armv7.zip` below. It's for Gen1 (32-bit) MPCs on MPC OS 3.x and has been tested on an MPC One. Install it with the [Open MPC](https://open-mpc.github.io/) installer app, or follow `INSTALL.md` inside the zip. Save your project first, because installing restarts the MPC.

Ideas, bugs and criticism are all welcome. [Open an issue](https://github.com/PotentialBreakfast/mpc-vst-potentialpunch/issues/new/choose).
